ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its tables. The script of a project reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.script-db owns it.

rules.order: The blocks are read in the order of position, 0, 1, 2...; a block is added after a chosen one or at the end, moves one place up or down, and leaves without a gap.
rules.profile: The script is written with one script profile (script_profile, one row: its code and the whole profile as it was when chosen, user 2026-10-28: the form of the script is programmable). A block's kind is a code of that profile; a block of a kind it does not have is refused, and a profile without a kind the blocks have is refused. A project read on another computer keeps the profile it was written with.
rules.text: A block of a text kind (spoken, anchor, note) is never empty; its length comes from its words and the project's audio.reading_words_per_second, or from its recording when its kind is recorded (only a recorded kind takes one).
rules.pieces: A clip block may be put together from several ranges (SubSegment; pieces_json: clip, IN, OUT, timecodes, length, seconds and the words of each part, in order). Its clip, IN and start timecode are its first part's, its end timecode the last part's, its length all of them, its text the parts' words one under another. A part without a range, or a part of a block that is not a clip, is refused. A block of one range keeps no parts. Every part after the first keeps the pause before it (gap_before, frames of black and silence) and whether its sound joins the part before with a cut or the project audio.crossfade_frames crossfade (cut; user 2026-10-29: "we will test which is better"), SetJoin.
rules.fields: A block keeps the values of its kind's fields (fields_json, by field code; for example the caption of a statement or the template and lines of a graphic). A field the kind does not have, or a choice not among its choices, is refused; an empty value is none. The cue label of a kind may name a field (`{code}`).
rules.voice: A block of a recorded kind has one voice record (user 2026-10-30): script_voice keeps its name (<project>_<mark>, given at its first take and kept when blocks move), its clip (one MXF of several mono channels, take n on channel n, all from the clip's start) and the take used (chosen); script_voice_takes keeps every take in the order recorded: its WAV, length, the time of day it started and the block's text as it was then. A take comes only as the next number (at most 8) and becomes the one used; the block keeps the clip, the length of the take used and the timecode of the first take (the clip's). A removed block takes its record with it; the files stay (the project folder lets none be deleted). A take keeps the words heard in it (heard_json: text and seconds in the take, user 2026-11-08), written by the background once and no step of undo. A reading found in a recording made elsewhere (user 2026-11-10: a camera, a recorder, LAN or intranet) keeps source_json: the clip of the project it is a range of, its frames there at its rate and the camera channel heard; its wav_uri is that clip's media and its words are seconds from the range's start; nothing is copied or cut.
rules.marks: A text block keeps its M markers (marks_json, user 2026-11-08): each the number of the word it stands before, never the first. A marker stays with its word when the text is edited and goes when its word is deleted; each change is one step of undo.
rules.clip: A block of a clip kind (a statement, a stand-up...) is a clip's frames [from_frame, to_frame) with its timecodes, length and seconds as shown when it was added, and the words said there (which may be corrected); it needs a clip and an IN before its OUT.
